name: Yuri's Love
source:
In this game you play as Yuri, a 18-year-old cat who is on his last day of school. He hopes one day he will find love, but for that YOU need to help him!

[Edit from [url=https://danicreates.itch.io/yuris-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在本作中，你将扮演18岁的猫尤里。今天是他在学校的最后一天。他盼望着有朝一日能找到爱情，而这需要你的帮助！

[编译自[url=https://danicreates.itch.io/yuris-love]Itch.io[/url]]
